entries.name: dried onion
entries.description: Dried onion is onion in dried or dehydrated form, used as a named food ingredient. This broad form does not specify flakes, granules or powder.

evidence.excerpt: dried or dehydrated onions and garlic

entries.name: dried garlic
entries.description: Dried garlic is garlic in dried or dehydrated form, used as a named food ingredient. This broad form does not specify flakes, granules or powder.

evidence.excerpt: dried or dehydrated onions and garlic

entries.name: green cardamom powder
entries.description: Green cardamom powder is a ground cardamom spice associated with Elettaria cardamomum. This record does not cover black cardamom.

evidence.excerpt: CARDAMOM (or Cardamon) - The dried, nearly ripe fruit or seed of Elettaria cardamomum L. Maton.
in the whole, broken, or ground form

entries.name: red chilli powder
entries.description: Red chilli powder is a ground red Capsicum pepper spice. This record does not identify an unspecified chilli-powder seasoning blend.

evidence.excerpt: PEPPER, RED (Capsicum, Cayenne) - The red, dried fruit of any variety of Capsicum frutescens L. or C. annuum L.
in the whole, broken, or ground form

entries.name: coriander extract
entries.description: Coriander extract is a plant-derived extractive used as a flavour ingredient. The label does not specify its extraction method or composition.

entries.name: cumin extract
entries.description: Cumin extract is a plant-derived extractive used as a flavour ingredient. The label does not specify its extraction method or composition.

entries.name: iodized salt
entries.description: Iodized salt is food salt with added iodine compounds. The ingredient name alone does not specify the iodine compound or its amount.

evidence.excerpt: iodized salt or iodized table salt
salt for human food use to which iodide has been added

entries.name: disodium 5'-ribonucleotides
entries.description: Disodium 5'-ribonucleotides is the additive identified as E635 in the UK Food Standards Agency register. The code identifies the additive, not its amount in a product.

evidence.excerpt: E No. E 635 Food Additive Disodium 5′-ribonucleotides

entries.name: natural flavouring
entries.description: Natural flavouring is a broad category of flavour ingredients derived from plant, animal or fermentation sources. This label term does not identify the individual substances in the flavouring.

evidence.excerpt: The term natural flavor or natural flavoring means
whose significant function in food is flavoring rather than nutritional
